events.title: ECOSLO Creeks to Coast Cleanup – Cayucos Beach
events.organizer: ECOSLO (Environmental Center of San Luis Obispo)
events.summary: Free volunteer beach cleanup 9am–noon at Cayucos Pier, part of California Coastal Cleanup Day. All ages welcome; supplies provided.

events.title: Cayucos Fall Antique Street Faire
events.venue: N. Ocean Avenue (Cayucos Drive to E Street), Downtown Cayucos
events.summary: 40th edition of the twice-yearly outdoor faire. ~100 vendors selling antiques, vintage & collectibles along Ocean Ave, 7am–3pm. Free, dog-friendly, rain or shine.

events.title: 35th Annual Cayucos Car Show – Check-in Party
events.venue: Nelson's Garage, 50 S. Ocean Ave, Cayucos
events.summary: Registered exhibitor kick-off party at Nelson's Garage with appetizers & cocktails the evening before the main car show.

events.title: 35th Annual Cayucos Car Show
events.summary: Classic cars line downtown Cayucos 8am–4pm with a live band, beer garden & Lions BBQ. Rain or shine. Proceeds benefit local nonprofits.

events.title: Christmas in Cayucos – Tree Lighting & Open House
events.organizer: Cayucos Chamber of Commerce / Cayucos Lioness Club
events.summary: Annual holiday open house with community tree lighting, Santa & Mrs. Claus, carriage rides, kids' crafts & Lioness Club refreshments. Free.
